Title: [P0][outline][backend+frontend] Fix stream 94% timeout and chapter-5 truncation completion loop
Description: Stabilize outline missing-chapter completion for large chapter targets by replacing fixed small retry policy with progressive batch scheduling, and keep SSE alive during completion so stream does not drop at 94%; align frontend stream error/cancel state handling to avoid stuck modal UX.
Acceptance: Large chapter targets no longer stop after chapter 5 due premature completion policy; stream completion phase emits keepalive/progress and avoids idle disconnect; frontend shows consistent stream error/cancel state without stuck 94% panel.
Test_Method: cd backend; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m compileall -q app alembic; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest tests.test_outline_generation_guidance tests.test_prompt_preset_resources tests.test_llm_profile_sync_preset_defaults -v; cd frontend; npm run build
